text: Amazing how a store full of electronics can still fail to sell a working charger. After three returns and a lot of smiling apologies, I now own plenty of receipts and zero functioning devices.

The staff were consistently calm and professional while explaining why the warranty didn’t apply in my case. I left without a refund but with a much deeper understanding of the store’s return policy-something I hadn’t planned to study.
Nothing flashy, just a well-run electronics store. I asked for a specific set of noise-canceling headphones, got a clear explanation, paid exactly what I expected, and they’ve worked perfectly since.
Shockingly smooth experience for buying tech. The laptop was in stock, the price matched the tag, and no one tried to sell me an extended warranty I didn’t ask for. I’d call that a win.
It’s an electronics store that does what it claims to do. The product works, the transaction was completed, and I don’t have much else to say-which probably says everything.
The store has a wide selection and reasonable prices, though the staff interaction felt rushed. I got what I needed, but the experience didn’t stand out enough to feel particularly good or bad.
